reasons: Aggregation differs: Datadog sum:... across series is a sum, but the candidate wraps the selector in avg(), which gives a different value whenever more than one series exists.

Series set differs: the $host template variable has tag prefix host and default *, so it should become a matcher such as host label =~"$host". The candidate omits it. The dataset label for the host is not listed in dataset_labels, so the exact label name cannot be confirmed from the given data.
The $scope variable has no prefix and default *, so dropping it is correct. The $key variable is not referenced by the query and is ignored.

The OTel metric redis.rdb.changes_since_last_save (non-monotonic sum, unit {change}) appears to measure the same changes-since-last-save count, so the metric choice and unit are acceptable. Outcome translated is correct because no function is used.
Since the metric is a non-monotonic sum, no rate() is applied, which is correct.
